name: Affise
what_it_is: A partner marketing platform whose product line includes Affise Performance for affiliate and partner tracking and a mobile attribution product (Affise MMP).
platforms: Mobile apps (mobile attribution product); affiliate tracking for web and app campaigns
pricing: The pricing page lists Affise Performance plans from $499 per month on yearly billing ($625 monthly) with a 14-day trial; the mobile attribution product is sold through Talk to an expert and its prices are not listed in the opened text.
notable: Homepage says mobile attribution is for marketers and mobile application developers

facts.fact: Affise's homepage presents Affise MMP (Mobile Measurement Partner) and a Mobile Attribution product for marketers and mobile application developers.
The homepage says Affise is trusted by 1,000+ customers worldwide.
The pricing page lists Affise Performance plans Beginner, Core, Expand and Custom, from $499 per month on yearly billing ($625 monthly) up to $1,999 ($2,499 monthly), each with a 14-day trial.
The pricing page headline covers affiliate tracking software plans and the page directs mobile attribution buyers to Talk to an expert.
